text:

author: D4162QYalisonp

title: Well worth doing
text: Lorraine was super friendly & informative.   The restaurants chosen were not noisy and the Tapas selected was very good. Unfortunately our Flamenco show (it was amazing) was delayed by 1.5hrs but all in all, well worth it.
author: brucemS6593EP

title: Tapas and flamingo dancing
text:
Lorena was an excellent hostess! She was friendly, knowledgeable and very professional. She answered all of our questions and was very patient when we had trouble with our translation challenges.

Great overall experience!
author: ramonarG8205PX

title: Great tapas and flamenco
text: What an excellent tapas tour! Our guide Lorena was informative and very fun. The food and wine were varied and delicious. She took care of our needs and was very communicative in advance. Highly recommend this tour.
author: Eggwyt

title: Local tour & food tasting in Sevilla!
text: Excellent experience! Lorena was a fun & informative guide! The food was absolutely delicious & plentiful! Great local eateries for tapas!
author: Lamae K

title: Excellent tour to get to know the place
text:
This is a very nice way to see Seville and try different food and local drinks. Loreena our guide was very knowledgeable of the history and did a great job. So pleased that they went ahead on the tour with just the two of us so we got a private tour.
The flamingo is in stunning all building worth a visit
Highly recommend touring with this company
author: AMCSydney

title: Unforgettable evening in Seville
text:
Sergio was an amazing guidee, super fun and friendly.
The food was absolutely delicious, and the flamenco show was truly impressive. A perfect plan for a night out in Seville!
author: Laura B
